column1: # MANUALLY MANAGED: independent retail data extents, never candidate-derived sizes.
# Names remain source-owned. Evidence must cite the retail boundary justification.
# Categories: object, system, padding, provisional. End = rva + size, exclusive.
# padding rows are the only padding coverage credits (homm3.verify.padding):
# section, observed fill (00/CC/90/mixed), preceding and following claim
# (name | file:line | type | sizeof), the alignment that explains the gap and
# a proof class: proven-end, or after-byte-array / after-literal /
# after-unknown-type / after-unverified (a longer retail datum would end in
# the same fill). Seeded 2026-09-29 from `homm3 verify padding --propose`.
# Vtables and PE import structures are read directly by sema coverage; do not duplicate them here.
